essence: The practitioner should perform the thread-cutting on all sides by means of the fire seed-syllable.
One should perform this procedure eleven times in all ritual actions.
In the killing rite involving delusion and hatred, one should employ smoky and black forms.
The drawn breaths of the target should be placed in the practitioner's own heart.
The target's breaths should be visualized as frogs and the practitioner's own as snakes.
